summary: Re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_iter29_soft_cascade_delete.py after the $unset fix to _cascade_delete_user. All 19 tests PASSED (previously 10 failing due to E11000 DuplicateKeyError on username_1 sparse index). Soft cascade delete, bulk delete response shape (deleted/soft_deleted/succeeded/failed), idempotent delete, favorites wipe, and public listing exclusion all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix using $unset on username/avatar_url correctly avoids sparse unique index collision. Consider adding the same pattern for any other unique-sparse fields that may be introduced later.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral seller/customer users via public signup; cleanup handled by soft delete under test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter29 fix is verified. Full test file passes in ~48s. Any future auth/user-deletion regression tests can reuse this file.
rca of the issue: Previous iter29 failed because _cascade_delete_user used $set:{username:null,avatar_url:null}. The `username_1` index is unique+sparse; sparse skips only when field is missing, not when it's explicitly null. Second delete triggered E11000. Fix: use $unset:{username:'',avatar_url:''} which removes the fields entirely, letting the sparse index skip them. Verified fix: 19/19 tests pass.
